notes: Research starter dataset for a tourism website/API.
GPS coordinates, opening hours, visit duration and facilities are left blank where they were not reliably verified.
Entry fees are populated only where current Nepal Tourism Board information was found.
Some records are route stops, villages, park entrances or tourism areas rather than standalone attractions.
Maula Kalika Temple is in Gaindakot/Nawalpur, across the Narayani River from Chitwan, and is included only as a nearby attraction.
